Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass the Bluefin/Albany detail to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't mention it in any channel.

I also can't confirm it, since it's secondhand from Mateo and I haven't seen anything that backs it up. If you want to brief Ruth, that's your call. I can help you draft a note for her, but I'd want you to tell me first that you're happy for it to go to her.
